_provenance: FROZEN held-out set for org oss-pallets. Written from the overlay ADR texts (acme-handbook ADR-101..108), the runbook titles and the repository file listing ONLY. No live-model OSS plan output had been generated or viewed when this file was written (OSS embeddings were still being built). Never used for prompt or code tuning; changes after the commit that introduces it invalidate the held-out claim and must be reported as such.

_scoring.buckets: Decisions: required (must appear -> else FAIL), excluded (must not appear -> FAIL), unlisted (everything else: reported for review, never auto-failed; NOT adjudicated on held-out). Risks: required_risks (must appear), allowed_subjects (relevant, reported), anything else is unlisted/review. Reuse: allowed_reuse_components, anything else is unlisted/review.
_scoring.reporting: counts per set (dev / held-out), no percentages
_scoring.subject_id_form: <repo>:<path>, e.g. flask:src/flask/cli.py; '*' matches within a path segment sequence (fnmatch)
